credits.title: O.M: Operation Mole
credits.overview: Set across the temple corridors of Tirupati and Tiruvannamalai, an elite undercover operative infiltrates a sprawling transnational red sanders syndicate. As criminal politics escalate, a covert task force launches Operation Mole to dismantle the cartel from within.

credits.title: Modha Rathri
credits.overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

credits.title: Pebbles
credits.overview: A young boy follows his violent and alcoholic father on a quest to find his mother, who has run away from his abuse.
